annotations.title: Price history for a product URL

description: True price (the lowest price the product really sold at that we know of, from daily checks and archived snapshots: `true_price`), price history, deal score, checked promo code and product spec (description, tags, options, SKUs, weights, images) for a product page URL of a Shopify store Trueprice tracks (e.g. https://example.com/products/blue-mug). History (`points`) starts the day Trueprice first read the product; `archived` holds earlier prices from archived copies of the store's page (Wayback Machine, since 2025-01), labelled "archived snapshot": snapshots, not daily checks, and not used in the stats or deal score.

url.description: The product page URL; a ?variant=<id> in it returns that option's own history

name: lookup_price
